HADESANCIENTS-DEATH.title: Death
HADESANCIENTS-DEATH.flavor: Some mortals would sense his soft approach, others taken by surprise.
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINITY.title: Divinity
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINITY.description: Every other combat, a random card in each card reward is [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-DIVINITY.flavor: The privilege of godhood is bestowed at birth, save for the rarest cases, when it is earned.
HADESANCIENTS-ETERNITY.title: Eternity
HADESANCIENTS-ETERNITY.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, ALL enemies lose [blue]{StrengthLoss:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
HADESANCIENTS-ETERNITY.flavor: The inevitable cannot be prevented, though perhaps can be forestalled.
HADESANCIENTS-EXCELLENCE.title: Excellence
HADESANCIENTS-EXCELLENCE.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] normal combats, obtain an additional Rare card reward.
HADESANCIENTS-EXCELLENCE.flavor: Not even gods can live to their fullest purpose; yet mortals all must strive.
HADESANCIENTS-JUDGEMENT.title: Judgement
HADESANCIENTS-JUDGEMENT.description: At the start of each future Act, obtain [blue]{RelicsToObtain}[/blue] random Arcana Relics.
HADESANCIENTS-JUDGEMENT.flavor: The Underworld King is to decide what shall become of each and every mortal life.
HADESANCIENTS-NIGHT.title: Night
HADESANCIENTS-NIGHT.description: The [blue]3rd[/blue] Attack played each combat is played an additional time.
HADESANCIENTS-NIGHT.flavor: She sprang from Chaos, and formed much of the natural world, above the surface and below.
HADESANCIENTS-ORIGINATION.title: Origination
HADESANCIENTS-ORIGINATION.description: Your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamagePercent}%[/blue] more damage to enemies with at least [blue]{DebuffsThreshold}[/blue] different Debuffs.
HADESANCIENTS-ORIGINATION.flavor: From the infinite void emerged all that exists, and back to that void it all may yet return.
HADESANCIENTS-PERSISTENCE.title: Persistence
HADESANCIENTS-PERSISTENCE.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP. Start each Elite or Boss combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-PERSISTENCE.flavor: He stole from the gods the gift of fire, for mortals; thus he suffered, but grew strong.
HADESANCIENTS-STRENGTH.title: Strength
HADESANCIENTS-STRENGTH.description: While your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-STRENGTH.flavor: The power to surpass the might of the gods is one that must always be held in check.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ARTIFICER.title: The Artificer
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ARTIFICER.description: The next [blue]{Times}[/blue] times you discard a Potion during combat, obtain an additional Relic reward.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ARTIFICER.flavor: Few can turn raw materials into works into work of extraordinary genius; none as can he.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_BOATMAN.title: The Boatman
HADESANCIENTS-THE_BOATMAN.description: The next Relic you buy in a shop is free.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_BOATMAN.flavor: Vast riches lie hidden in the realm of the dead; but only a modest fee is needed to get in.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_CENTAUR.title: The Centaur
HADESANCIENTS-THE_CENTAUR.flavor: Many of the greatest heroes mortalkind has to offer have in common his patient instructions.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_CHAMPIONS.title: The Champions
HADESANCIENTS-THE_CHAMPIONS.description: The next [blue]{RelicRewards}[/blue] Relic rewards from Elites offer [blue]{RelicsToOffer}[/blue] Relics to choose from.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_CHAMPIONS.flavor: Once-mortal foes, they found each other once again in death, and were exalted in Elysium.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ENCHANTRESS.title: The Enchantress
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ENCHANTRESS.descriptio: For the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, each card in Card Rewards gains a random Enchantment.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_ENCHANTRESS.flavor: In mastering metamorphosis, she discovered that only the true nature of a thing cannot be changed.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FATES.title: The Fates
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FATES.description: For the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, you may reroll each card reward once.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FATES.flavor: Even the gods themselves are subject to the whims of the three weavers of destiny.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FURIES.title: The Furies
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FURIES.description: Your Attacks deal [blue]{MoreDamagePercent}%[/blue] more damage to enemies that do not intend to attack.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_FURIES.flavor: In the deepest reaches of the Underworld, three are as feared as the god of the dead himself.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_HUNTRESS.title: The Huntress
HADESANCIENTS-THE_HUNTRESS.description: Your Attacks that cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} deal [blue]{MoreDamage}[/blue] additional damage, and you gain [blue]{MoreBlock}[/blue] additional [gold]Block[/gold] from Skills that cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)}.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_HUNTRESS.flavor: Through discipline and instinct comes sustaining skill both in shadow and the light of the moon.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_LOVERS.title: The Lovers
HADESANCIENTS-THE_LOVERS.description: At the start of each Elite or Boss combat, apply [blue]{InfatuatedPower}[/blue] [gold]Infatuated[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_LOVERS.flavor: Their music brought them together, and not even Death could keep them apart for long.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MESSENGER.title: The Messenger
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MESSENGER.description: The first time each combat you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills in a single turn, gain [blue]{BufferPower}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MESSENGER.flavor: With incomparable swiftness can he travel from the highest peaks to the lowest depths.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MOON.title: The Moon
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MOON.description: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_MOON.flavor: Even as she races across the fathomless sky, she bears witness to all.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_QUEEN.title: The Queen
HADESANCIENTS-THE_QUEEN.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] normal combats, obtain a card reward from another character.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_QUEEN.flavor: From Olympus she descends to reign in Underworld as the surface-land grows cold.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SORCERESS.title: The Sorceress
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SORCERESS.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SORCERESS.flavor: Left to her own devices, she learned to confront the world on her own terms.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SWIFT_RUNNER.title: The Swift Runner
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SWIFT_RUNNER.descripti: You may ignore paths when traveling to and from Shops.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_SWIFT_RUNNER.flavor: Those who attempted to confront the greatest of the Greeks merely met his spear.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_UNSEEN.title: The Unseen
HADESANCIENTS-THE_UNSEEN.flavor: Upon their ancient oath, in shadow, they serve; and to shadow, they return.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_WAYWARD_SON.title: The Wayward Son
HADESANCIENTS-THE_WAYWARD_SON.descriptio: At the end of each combat, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
HADESANCIENTS-THE_WAYWARD_SON.flavor: Even the Underworld itself struggled to contain him, such was his lust for life.
